data.title: 艾尔菲利亚 · 至高魔导塔冰晶王座主控跨坐
data.description: 极冰的至高魔法使。艾尔菲利亚将繁复神圣的雪白法袍解开，跨坐在你的腰间。冰蓝色的长发垂落，冰蓝色的双眸温柔得让人心碎，那对神圣的雪峰在冰晶反光下剧烈颠簸——「为了追上我……吃了那么多苦……今晚就由艾尔菲来治愈你的一切疲惫吧，威尔。」
data.location: 至高塔至高之杖神殿·深夜
data.action: 跨坐冰晶王座雪白法袍大敞，冰蓝长发垂落，冰蓝眼眸深情微颤主动下沉
data.lighting: blue light from the ice throne and floating magical orbs, with soft reflections on the white robe
data.promptProse: Atop the silent tower sanctuary at night, Elfaria Alvis Serfort straddles her partner on a crystalline ice throne with her embroidered white ceremonial robe opened wide across her bare breasts. Cradling his face in both palms with deep, trembling affection, she is bathed in cool blue radiance from drifting magic orbs and glistening frost, seen from below.
data.nsfwProse: Her embroidered white ceremonial mage robe falls wide open across her chest, baring her breasts as she sinks gently onto her partner atop the crystalline ice throne.
data.animaCaption: Straddling the viewer atop the crystalline ice throne with her embroidered white robe parted wide to bare her chest, she cradles their face in both hands with trembling, devoted eyes. Floating blue magic orbs and frost light shimmer across the white fabric and her flushed cheeks.
